messages.content:
CRITICAL EXACT SPELLING — use ONLY these names, do NOT invent alternatives:
- "Chain Table (CT)", "Target Table (TT)", "Iteration Stride Tracker (IST)"
- "IMAD.WIDE", "LDG.E", "SpMV", "IMA", "GRASP", "Prefetch"

Render a publication-quality academic diagram for MICRO/ISCA/HPCA. 16:9, 7.0" IEEE. Sans-serif labels, Monospace code. NO title. NO shadows. NO gradients. White background. Black outlines 1-1.5pt.

This is iteration 2. Fix these EXACT issues from iteration 1:
1. TT header MUST be clearly PURPLE #6C3483 (NOT blue) — it must be visually distinct from CT's blue header
2. TT data row 0: Base Address must read "c[0x0][0x180]" exactly, NOT garbled
3. Convergence arrows must be THICKER (1.5pt+) and more prominent
4. IST text must be larger and readable

=== LAYOUT (4 zones, left-to-right bias) ===
Upper-left (40% width, 35% height): SpMV CUDA code in light gray #F5F5F5 box
Upper-right (56% width, 35% height): SASS Assembly in light gray #F5F5F5 box
Middle (full width, thin): Formula Addr_target = base + scale x index
Lower-left (66% width): Chain Table (CT) — BLUE #2B5EA7 header
Lower-right top (28% width): Target Table (TT) — PURPLE #6C3483 header
Lower-right bottom (28% width): IST block — BLUE #2B5EA7 outlined

=== SpMV CUDA SOURCE (upper-left) ===
Label: "SpMV CUDA Kernel" gray italic.
Code (monospace):
  // CSR SpMV (base.cu:22)
  for (int offset = row_begin;
       offset < row_end; offset++) {
    sum += Ax[offset] * x[Aj[offset]];
  }
"Aj[offset]" blue underline = "Index Load". "x[...]" amber underline = "Data Load".

=== SASS ASSEMBLY (upper-right) ===
Label: "SASS Assembly (x16 Unrolled Loop)".
Three groups with RIGHT-SIDE colored brackets:

BLUE bracket "IMA Index Loads":
  *0x03d0* LDG.E R9, [R6+-0x8]     (blue bold)
  *0x03e0* LDG.E R27, [R6+-0x4]    (blue bold)
  ... (13 more index loads)          (gray italic)

PURPLE bracket "Addr Generation":
  *0x0480* IMAD.WIDE R8, R9, R16, c[0x180]     (purple bold)
  *0x0490* IMAD.WIDE R26, R27, R16, c[0x180]   (purple bold)
  ... (14 more IMAD.WIDEs)                       (gray italic)

AMBER bracket "IMA Data Loads":
  *0x04a0* LDG.E R14, [R8]     (amber bold)
  *0x04c0* LDG.E R24, [R26]    (amber bold)
  ... (14 more data loads)       (gray italic)
  *0x0580* FFMA R14, R14, R18, R11   (gray, accumulation)

=== FORMULA (centered) ===
Addr_target = base + scale x index
"base" purple, "scale" purple, "index" blue, "Addr_target" amber.

=== TARGET TABLE (TT) — MUST be PURPLE #6C3483 header ===
Header bar: SOLID PURPLE #6C3483 fill, WHITE bold text "Target Table (TT)" left, "8 entries" right.
THIS HEADER MUST BE CLEARLY PURPLE, NOT BLUE.

Columns grouped:
Group "Entry": Idx
Group "Status": V (Valid)
Group "Target Descriptor": Base Address | Scale | Type

Row 0: 0 | green square | c[0x0][0x180] | 4B | f32
Row 1: 1 | green square | 0x7FC4B7E40000 | 4B | f32
Row 2: 2 | green square | 0x7FC4B8100000 | 8B | f64
Row 3: 3 | gray dash | — | — | —

Below table: "CAM: lookup by (base, scale)" italic annotation.

=== CHAIN TABLE (CT) — BLUE #2B5EA7 header ===
Header: SOLID BLUE #2B5EA7 fill, WHITE bold text "Chain Table (CT)" left, "32 entries" right.

Grouped columns with tinted sub-headers:
Identification (#E8F0FE): V | Index PC
Target Mapping (#F0E8F8): tt_idx[0] | [1] | [2] | K
Stride Learning (#FFF8E1): Iter Stride | Stride Valid

Data rows:
Row 0: green sq | 0x03d0 | 0 | - | - | 1 | 64 B | TRUE (green)
Row 1: green sq | 0x03e0 | 0 | - | - | 1 | 64 B | TRUE (green)
Row 2: green sq | 0x0A20 | 0 | 1 | - | 2 | 16 B | TRUE (green)
... (ellipsis row)

=== IST BLOCK ===
Title "Iteration Stride Tracker (IST)" bold above.
Blue #2B5EA7 outlined box, white background.
Content (readable size, at least 8pt):
  PC 0x03d0, Warp 0:
  iter i:   A1 = 0x7FC4D0DA4864
  iter i+1: A2 = 0x7FC4D0DA48A4
  stride = A2 - A1 = 0x40 = 64 B
Note: "Any warp can contribute" italic.
Arrow LEFT to CT stride column.

=== ARROWS ===
1. SASS -> CT: BLACK solid from PC 0x03d0, 0x03e0 DOWN to CT rows. Circles ① ②. Label "CD detects chain".
2. CT -> TT CONVERGENCE (THE KEY VISUAL): THREE THICK (2pt) BLACK solid arrows from CT tt_idx[0] column (all showing "0") pointing RIGHT to TT Row 0. CONVERGING into one arrowhead. Bold text above: "16 CT entries -> 1 TT entry (many-to-one)". THESE MUST BE THE MOST PROMINENT ARROWS.
3. SASS -> TT: Gray dashed from IMAD.WIDE operands to TT columns.
4. IST -> CT: Thin arrow LEFT to CT stride column.

=== LEGEND (bottom) ===
Single line: filled blue square "Storage (Blue)" | filled purple square "Logic (Purple)" | empty square "External" | solid line "Training path" | dashed lines for Index PF and Data PF
